description: Soft-delete a model by owner/project/model, ul://owner/project/model, or slug with a project. Deleted models go to trash and remain restorable; weights, training history, and exports are removed only on permanent deletion.

model.description: Model ref by owner/project/model, ul:// URI, or slug (requires project).

project.description: Project ref required when model is given by slug.

name: models_delete
